categoryName: Toys & games — board games, puzzles, soft toys, outdoor play, hobby kits

skuLines.line: Classic Indian board games — ludo, snakes & ladders
skuLines.examples: Funskool Snakes & Ladders (₹235), Ratna's Ludo, Ekta 2-in-1 Ludo/S&L, unbranded paper-board ludo
skuLines.seasonality: Spikes in monsoon (Jul-Sep) and cold winter when outdoor play stops; term-start Apr
skuLines.notes: Cardboard boards warp and mildew in Baru Sahib damp — store off the floor on shelving, keep only 4-6 weeks cover. Cheapest ₹40 paper sets are the true volume line for boarders.

skuLines.examples: Funskool Travel Ludo ₹189, Travel Chess & Draughts ₹199, Travel Chinese Checkers ₹189, magnetic travel ludo
skuLines.seasonality: Term start and just before students travel home for breaks
skuLines.notes: Ideal hostel SKU — fits a locker, pieces don't scatter in a dorm. Light, so hill freight per rupee is good.

skuLines.line: Chess sets — plastic, wooden and tournament
skuLines.examples: Synco/Stag plastic tournament set, Chessbazaar wooden 14", Funskool chess, magnetic folding chess
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; spikes at inter-house/inter-college tournament season and winter
skuLines.notes: Carry a spare-pieces/spare-board option — dorm sets lose a knight, not a board. Digital chess clock is a low-volume, high-attach add-on for the university.

skuLines.line: Carrom board — full size and mid size
skuLines.examples: Synco 27" 4mm ₹2,199, Synco 36" Chakri ₹3,699, Precise/Surco full-size 20mm ₹6,000+
skuLines.seasonality: Hostel/common-room buying at session start (Apr) and after winter break
skuLines.notes: Worst freight-per-rupee item in the lane — huge volumetric weight up 30-50 km of hill road, and plywood absorbs monsoon damp then bows. Stock 2-4 pieces, sell mainly to institutions/common rooms, and keep them dry and flat, never leaning.

skuLines.examples: Synco carrom coins set, striker (acrylic/wooden), boric powder pouch, replacement dice/tokens
skuLines.packSizes: coin set of 19; single striker; 50-100g boric powder
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round, follows board usage
skuLines.notes: The highest-repeat, highest-margin line in the whole category and the one a campus store forgets. One carrom board in a hostel consumes boric powder and strikers all year. Tiny, light, no freight problem.

skuLines.examples: Ekta International Business ₹349, Ekta Business India, Monopoly (Hasbro), Monopoly Deal card game ₹210-349
skuLines.packSizes: single box; junior and deluxe variants
skuLines.seasonality: Monsoon and winter indoor season; gifting at Children's Day and birthdays
skuLines.notes: Big boxes take shelf depth. Fake/loose-print 'Business' copies are common in the wholesale channel — insist on BIS-marked branded stock.

skuLines.examples: Funskool Word Plus ₹599, Mattel Scrabble, Funskool Tambola ₹375, Ekta Housie Deluxe
skuLines.seasonality: Tambola/Housie spikes for staff-family gatherings, Diwali and annual-function evenings
skuLines.notes: Word games double as a teacher-approved English-practice purchase — school departments buy in 5-10 unit lots, which is a bulk order a campus store can actually win.

skuLines.examples: Mattel UNO ₹109, UNO Flip, Jenga, Dobble, Skip-Bo, Taboo
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; peaks during monsoon, exam-break weekends and hostel birthdays
skuLines.notes: UNO at ~₹109 is the single best-selling game SKU in Indian modern trade and q-commerce — treat it as a never-out-of-stock line. Decks get destroyed in dorms, so repeat rate is high.

skuLines.examples: Bicycle/Stag/local rummy deck, plastic-coated waterproof deck, twin-pack
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round
skuLines.notes: Judgement call, not a merchandising call: this is a Kalgidhar Trust campus and plain card decks read as gambling. Do NOT face them up at the POS counter; if stocked at all, keep them as a quiet staff-side item and clear it with the institution first. UNO/Dobble fill the same demand with no objection.

skuLines.examples: Kaadoo India-theme games, Sequence, Catan (entry box), Cubeleelo strategy titles
skuLines.seasonality: Gifting season Oct-Nov and Children's Day
skuLines.notes: Premium end of the lane — keep to 3-5 titles, one facing each. Slow turns, but it is the ₹1,500+ purchase that currently leaks to a trip to Chandigarh/Solan.

skuLines.examples: Frank India-map / alphabet puzzles, Webby 100-pc, Funskool floor puzzle, Ratna's tray puzzle
skuLines.seasonality: Monsoon and winter; gifting all year
skuLines.notes: India-map and alphabet puzzles sell as school-support, not toys. Boxes swell in damp — poly-bag or shrink-wrap the shelf stock.

skuLines.examples: Webby 1000-pc (Leh Market, Taj Mahal) ₹899-1,199, Ravensburger 500-pc, Frank 1000-pc
skuLines.seasonality: Strong in the long cold winter and monsoon shut-ins
skuLines.notes: Genuinely well-matched to a cold hill campus with long indoor evenings. Add a cheap felt puzzle-roll mat as the attach. Wooden-piece versions survive damp far better than card.

skuLines.examples: Cubelelo Drift 3x3 (₹180-300), original Rubik's 3x3, 2x2 and Pyraminx, mirror cube
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round, spikes in fads and after school cubing competitions
skuLines.notes: Fastest-moving pocket-money hobby line for ages 8-18 and completely non-perishable, light and dense in value — perfect hill-freight economics. Attach: cube lube, timer, stand, keychain 3x3.

skuLines.examples: Cubelelo metal wire puzzles, tangram set, 3D wooden interlocking puzzle, Sudoku/logic puzzle sets
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; return-gift season
skuLines.notes: Cheap, tiny, high margin, no expiry — the ideal impulse basket-builder next to the till.

skuLines.examples: Play Panda 200-pc block tub, Toyshine building blocks, Toy Cloud brick set, Sluban-type sets
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; gifting Oct-Nov
skuLines.notes: BIS IS 9873 mark is mandatory and small parts are a choking hazard — jumbo blocks only for under-3s, and keep the age grading visible on the shelf. This is the top staff-family gift purchase for ages 3-8.

skuLines.examples: Lego Classic small box, Mega Bloks first builders, Imagimake magnetic tiles, Mirada bricks
skuLines.packSizes: small box 100-300 pcs; 30-60 tile magnetic sets
skuLines.seasonality: Birthdays and Oct-Nov gifting
skuLines.notes: Slow-turning premium end; 2-3 SKUs is enough. Magnetic tiles have small magnets — never sell for under-3s.

skuLines.examples: Babique plush animals, Dimpy Stuff teddy 25cm, Toytales mini plush, Mirada keychain plush
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; peaks at birthdays, Children's Day (14 Nov), farewells and Rakhi
skuLines.notes: The everyday gifting engine for a residential campus — students gift each other constantly. Plush absorbs monsoon damp and starts to smell: keep sealed in poly bags, rotate stock, don't over-order before Jul-Sep.

skuLines.examples: Dimpy Stuff bear 45cm, Elan large plush, Just Bear 60cm teddy, Panda's Box jumbo plush
skuLines.seasonality: Birthdays, farewell/annual function, Oct-Nov
skuLines.notes: Very high volumetric freight for the value and it eats display space; carry 3-5 pieces as the visible 'big gift' anchor and take orders rather than deep-stocking. Compression-bagged inbound saves real money on hill transport.

skuLines.examples: Pop Mart-style blind box, collectible mini-plush series, Whumies-type plush, licensed character keyring plush
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round, fad-driven; strong after each term break when pocket money resets
skuLines.notes: The clearest 2025-26 trend in Indian toys and it maps exactly onto a closed campus, where trading and collecting spreads fast. Buy shallow and fast — fads die; and a display case sells better than loose pieces. Grey-market imports without BIS marking are a compliance risk.

skuLines.examples: Barbie (Mattel) entry SKU, Funskool baby doll, Indian-dress/ethnic doll, doll furniture & dress packs
skuLines.seasonality: Birthdays and Oct-Nov gifting
skuLines.notes: Institutional-fit matters here: choose modestly dressed and traditional/ethnic-dress dolls over swimwear or party-wear SKUs. Baby dolls sell to staff families with small children; fashion dolls to the school girls.

skuLines.examples: Funskool kitchen set, doctor set, tool kit, tea set, Toyshine cash-register/shop set
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; gifting peaks
skuLines.notes: Carry-case formats travel and store better than open blister boxes. Avoid weapon/gun role-play sets entirely — inappropriate for this institution.

skuLines.examples: Centy Toys bus/JCB/truck, Maisto die-cast car, Toyshine friction car set, Hot Wheels single
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round
skuLines.notes: Centy at ₹80-200 is the workhorse pocket-money and return-gift SKU. Metal, indestructible, no shelf life, dense value — perfect for hill logistics.

skuLines.examples: Toyshine RC car, battery-operated walking dog, Mirada RC stunt car, musical light-up toy
skuLines.seasonality: Birthdays and Oct-Nov gifting
skuLines.notes: Never sell one without the batteries — the commonest campus-store failure. Rechargeable RC packs die in cold storage, so don't hold stock over a full winter. Button-cell toys must be screw-secured (ingestion hazard with babies on campus).

skuLines.examples: Eveready/Duracell AA & AAA 4-pack, 9V, LR44/CR2032 button cells
skuLines.seasonality: Follows toy gifting; spike right after Oct-Nov and birthdays
skuLines.notes: Belongs in the toys plan even if the store books it elsewhere: it is the attach that makes every battery toy work and the reason a resident otherwise makes a 30-km trip. Batteries have ~3-5 yr shelf life but leak in damp — FIFO strictly.

skuLines.line: Baby rattles, teethers, squeeze & bath toys (0-18 m)
skuLines.examples: Mee Mee rattle set, Chicco play-set rattles, Funskool rattle, Shumee wooden teether, squeaky bath ducks
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round
skuLines.notes: Non-negotiable for a township with married staff families and babies. Must be BIS/IS 9873 marked, food-grade, phthalate-free, no detachable small parts. Teethers have a printed shelf life and perish — check dates on inward.

skuLines.examples: Funskool stacking rings, shape sorter, Mee Mee activity gym, pram/cot hanging musical toy, soft cloth book
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round
skuLines.notes: Pram/cot toys and play gyms are the standard newborn gift for a colleague on campus — a reliable, repeating staff purchase. Bulky play-gyms: 1-2 pieces only.

skuLines.examples: Toyzone tricycle, Luusa/Dash ride-on car, push walker with handle, rocking horse
skuLines.seasonality: Birthdays; spring/autumn when the weather allows outdoor use
skuLines.notes: Extreme volumetric freight up hill road for the value — this is the classic 'stock 2, sell the rest to order' line. Assembly is a real service opportunity. Plastic ride-ons go brittle after long UV/cold exposure, so don't display outdoors.

skuLines.examples: Hero/Hercules 14" kids cycle, Avon 16", BSA Champ 20", training wheels, bell, helmet
skuLines.packSizes: single boxed cycle (needs assembly); helmet S/M
skuLines.seasonality: Apr-Jun and post-monsoon Oct; dead in deep winter and monsoon
skuLines.notes: Big-ticket, freight-heavy, needs assembly and after-sales — only worth it because the alternative for a resident is a 30-50 km hill trip. Hill terrain makes brakes and helmet a real safety point, not an upsell. Attach: pump, puncture kit, chain oil, brake pads.

skuLines.line: Kick scooters, skates & skateboards + protective gear
skuLines.examples: 3-wheel LED kick scooter, Jaspo inline skates, Toyshine skateboard, knee/elbow pad set
skuLines.seasonality: Apr-Jun, Oct-Nov; unusable in monsoon
skuLines.notes: Baru Sahib's slopes and wet stone paths make this genuinely risk-prone — sell pads and helmet with every unit and stock only on flat-campus demand. Skate sizing needs try-on space.

skuLines.line: Play dough, modelling clay & kinetic sand
skuLines.examples: Funskool Fundough playset ₹532-649, Babyhug Fun Dough ₹149-244, Faber-Castell modelling clay ₹50-100, kinetic sand fort kit
skuLines.packSizes: single tub 60-100g; 4-8 colour packs; playset with moulds
skuLines.seasonality: Monsoon and winter indoor peak; art-week / craft-competition weeks
skuLines.notes: Real shelf life: dough dries out in 12-18 months and faster in a cold dry store — buy shallow, FIFO, keep lids sealed. Non-toxic marking required. Stains hostel bedding, so expect complaints if you push the glitter/slime variants.

skuLines.examples: Funskool glass painting kit ₹493-649, Intelliskills foam craft ₹209-499, DIY stamp art ₹199-349, Asian Hobby Crafts quilling/origami kit
skuLines.packSizes: single boxed kit; multi-craft combo box
skuLines.seasonality: Huge in monsoon and the long winter; craft-competition and annual-function weeks; Diwali/Gurpurab decoration making
skuLines.notes: This is arguably the highest-fit line in the lane for a residential school: 5,000 people indoors, an activity-hours problem, and school competitions all term. Kits with adhesive/paint have a 2-year shelf life and dry out — date-check inward.

skuLines.examples: DOMS Art Strokes kit ₹149, Camlin painting kit ₹199, Dabble finger paints, colouring book + crayon combo
skuLines.seasonality: Term start Apr, art competitions, monsoon
skuLines.notes: Sits on the border with stationery — decide which counter owns it so it doesn't get double-bought or dropped. Non-toxic/BIS marking on finger paints matters with toddlers on campus.

skuLines.examples: Glitter tubes, googly eyes, pom-poms, ice-cream sticks, coloured foam sheets, feathers, beads, glue-gun sticks
skuLines.packSizes: small packet / jar / loose by count
skuLines.seasonality: Project-submission weeks, annual function, Diwali/Gurpurab decor, science exhibition
skuLines.notes: The one line that prevents a whole hostel wing making an off-campus trip the night before a project. Tiny value, tiny freight, best margin in the category, but needs bin/jar display and a weighing/counting discipline at POS.

skuLines.examples: Smartivity Mega Science Kit ₹748, Butterfly EduFields 5-in-1 / 10-in-1 robotics ₹1,500-3,400, solar car kit, electronics breadboard kit
skuLines.seasonality: Science exhibition and project-submission season; Nov-Feb; term start
skuLines.notes: Sharpest 'captive demand' item in the lane — a school project cannot wait for a 30-km trip. Component QC on the cheaper robotics kits is genuinely patchy (documented complaints); open-box check at inward and keep a swap policy.

skuLines.examples: Skillmatics activity mats, Frank alphabet/number puzzle, wooden abacus, magnetic letters, flash-card packs
skuLines.packSizes: single boxed set; card packs of 50-100
skuLines.seasonality: Term start Apr; year-round for staff families
skuLines.notes: NEP-2020 play-based learning means the Academy's own primary section is a bulk buyer, not just parents — worth a school-department price list. Light, stackable, good freight.

skuLines.examples: Student microscope with slide set, 30x-60x pocket magnifier, refractor telescope entry model, prism/optics set
skuLines.seasonality: Term start; clear winter nights for the telescope
skuLines.notes: Baru Sahib's dark hill skies make an entry telescope a genuinely good-fit item for Eternal University students. Slow turn — 1-2 pieces, order-to-demand. Glass optics need protective packing on hill roads.

skuLines.examples: MM Toys plastic bat No.8 ₹245, wind ball 4-pack ₹240, plastic stumps set ₹270, Nivia/SG tennis-ball bat, hard-tennis cricket ball
skuLines.packSizes: bat sizes 3-8 & full; ball singles and 4/6-packs; stumps set
skuLines.seasonality: Apr-Jun and Sep-Nov peak; dead in monsoon and deep winter; spikes at IPL and inter-house tournaments
skuLines.notes: Balls are the repeat line, bats are the one-off — carry balls deep, bats shallow. Lost balls on a hill campus are a permanent, structural repeat sale. Attach: grip, tape, bat oil.

skuLines.examples: Yonex/Li-Ning entry racquet, kids' racquet set ₹129-500, Mavis 350 plastic shuttle tube, feather shuttle box, portable net
skuLines.packSizes: racquet single or 2-player set; shuttle tube of 6; net
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round — the default hill-station sport; peaks when wind is low (Oct-Feb) and indoors in monsoon
skuLines.notes: Highest-fit sport for a cold, wind-sheltered hill campus and the shuttlecock is a true consumable — feather shuttles last a session, plastic a month. Stock plastic (Mavis-type) deep, feather shallow. Attach: grip tape, restringing service.

skuLines.examples: Nivia football size 3/5, Cosco volleyball, Cosco basketball size 5/7, hand pump with needles
skuLines.seasonality: Sports day, inter-house season, Apr-Jun and Sep-Nov
skuLines.notes: Never stock balls without pumps and spare needles — a flat ball is a dead sale. Rubber-bladder balls lose pressure fast in cold; expect complaints in Dec-Feb that are physics, not a defect.

skuLines.line: Table tennis — bats, balls, portable nets
skuLines.examples: Stag/Gki TT bat, Cosco 3-star ball 6-pack, clamp-on retractable net set
skuLines.packSizes: bat single or 4-bat set; ball 3/6-pack; net
skuLines.seasonality: Peaks in monsoon and winter — the indoor sport of choice
skuLines.notes: Balls are the consumable and they get stepped on constantly in hostels; carry 6-packs deep. A clamp-on net turns any dining table into a table, which is exactly what a common room needs.

skuLines.examples: Toyshine Junior Fast Sling Puck, Wembley Pick & Drop, mini finger basketball, velcro/magnetic dart board, indoor bowling set, air-hockey lite
skuLines.seasonality: Strong through the monsoon (Jul-Sep) and cold winter
skuLines.notes: Sling-puck and pick-and-drop are currently top movers on Indian q-commerce and they solve the real Baru Sahib problem: months where nobody can go outside. Use velcro/magnetic darts only — steel-tip darts have no place in a school hostel.

skuLines.examples: PVC skipping rope with bearings ₹190, hula hoop, flying disc ₹20-150, velcro catch-ball set, throw rings
skuLines.seasonality: Apr-Jun, Sep-Nov; skipping continues indoors year-round
skuLines.notes: Cheapest way to serve a large sports-day/PT demand; skipping ropes are also the staff-fitness item. Light and coilable — best freight profile in the sports group.

skuLines.examples: Bubble solution bottle & bubble gun, kite + cotton thread spool (charkhi), yo-yo, flying spinner, paper caps/whistles
skuLines.seasonality: Kites peak at Lohri/Basant Panchami (mid-Jan to Feb); bubbles Apr-Jun
skuLines.notes: LICENCE POINT: Chinese/nylon/synthetic manjha is banned nationally (NGT order) and is a genuine injury and legal risk — stock cotton thread only and say so on the shelf card. Bubble solution evaporates and leaks in transit; upright cartons only.

skuLines.examples: Hand-pump pichkari, tank/backpack water gun, water balloons pack, character pichkari
skuLines.seasonality: 3-4 week window before Holi (Feb-Mar) and effectively zero for the rest of the year
skuLines.notes: Buy once, land it 4 weeks ahead of Holi, and plan to sell through — unsold pichkaris hold 11 months of dead stock and hill freight is too dear to reorder mid-season. Latex balloons perish in cold damp storage; small balloon pieces are a choking hazard for the babies on campus.

skuLines.examples: Goyal's fidget spinner ring, pop-it/popper, squishy, slime tub, rainbow spring coil, invisible-ink magic pen
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round, fad-driven; spikes right after term starts and pocket money lands
skuLines.notes: Highest-margin, highest-frequency, lowest-freight line in the lane and the true pocket-money engine of a 5,000-person campus with students aged 5-25. Buy shallow and rotate — every fad dies in 8-12 weeks. Slime dries out and stains; check school policy before pushing it.

skuLines.examples: Whistles, marbles/kancha packs, small tops, stickers/tattoo sheets, mini puzzle keychains, finger puppets
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; term time only
skuLines.notes: Sold by the piece from counter jars, this is the daily-footfall line for the 5-12 year olds — and it is why the 7.2 bills/resident/month number exists. Loose unbranded pieces must still be BIS-compliant; avoid anything with detachable parts for the youngest boarders.

skuLines.examples: Toyshine stationery return-gift combo, 12-piece return-gift assortment, mini-toy party pack
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round birthdays; peaks around Children's Day and annual function
skuLines.notes: On a closed campus, every child's birthday is a 20-40 unit purchase and there is nowhere else to buy it. Selling pre-made packs beats selling 20 loose toys — faster at the POS and higher basket value.

skuLines.examples: Balloons pack, birthday caps, foil 'Happy Birthday' banner, paper danglers, gift bags & wrapping paper, ribbon
skuLines.packSizes: balloon packs of 25-100; single banner; gift bag S/M/L
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round birthdays; festival/function decoration spikes Oct-Nov and annual day
skuLines.notes: Inseparable from the toy sale — the gift and its wrap are one trip. Latex balloons perish in cold damp within months and uninflated balloon pieces are a choking hazard around toddlers; date-rotate and keep them off the toddler shelf.

skuLines.examples: Shumee wooden pull-along and stacker, Channapatna lacquered wooden toys, wooden shape sorter, Ekta wooden blocks
skuLines.seasonality: Gifting Oct-Nov; year-round for newborn gifts
skuLines.notes: The clearest premium trend (non-toxic, sustainable, NEP-friendly) and it survives Baru Sahib's damp far better than card or plush. Needs food-grade/non-toxic lacquer certification. Wood swells in monsoon — keep sealed and off concrete floors.

skuLines.examples: Kids' 37-key keyboard, mini dholak/tabla set, harmonica, ukulele, tambourine & rhythm sticks, kids' guitar
skuLines.seasonality: Term start; annual function and Gurpurab kirtan practice season
skuLines.notes: Distinctive institutional fit — Akal Academy teaches Gurmat Sangeet, so beginner rhythm and keyboard instruments have a real, recurring, school-endorsed demand a normal toy shelf would never see. Serious harmonium/tabla belongs to a music-instrument line, not toys. Fragile in transit.

skuLines.examples: Toy storage bin, puzzle roll-up felt mat, cube display stand, zip pouch for game pieces, board-game protector sleeves
skuLines.seasonality: Term start; after gifting season
skuLines.notes: Small but real in a hostel where a game with three lost pieces is a dead game, and in a damp climate where a sealed box is the difference between a two-year and a two-monsoon life.

trends2026: Blind-box and collectible-plush mania (Pop Mart/Labubu-style, ₹299-₹1,199) has crossed into India and is spreading through school and college peer groups by trading — the single fastest-moving new sub-line, but fad-cyclical, so buy shallow and rotate.

STEM / educational toys are the premium growth engine: India's educational-toy market was ~$2.33 bn in 2025 growing ~8% CAGR, pulled by NEP-2020's play-based-learning mandate for under-8s, which turns schools themselves into institutional buyers.

'Made in India' has become the default: toy imports fell over 70% (from ~$371 mn in FY19 to ~$110 mn in FY22) and India flipped to a toy trade surplus, so domestic brands (Funskool, Ratna's, Ekta, Centy, Smartivity, Butterfly EduFields, Imagimake, Shumee) now dominate the buyable assortment.

BIS toy-safety licensing (IS 9873) is now enforced at scale — ~1,786 domestic and 56 foreign licences granted as of May 2026 — which makes unbranded/grey-market loose toys a compliance liability, not just a quality risk.

Quick commerce has made toys a 10-minute impulse category (Blinkit alone lists ~4,000 toy SKUs), resetting price expectations and normalising the small ₹100-₹300 toy as an everyday purchase rather than a festival one.

Speedcubing and skill-puzzle culture keeps compounding: sub-₹300 magnetic 3x3s from Indian brands like Cubelelo have made it a mainstream school hobby with its own accessory tail (lube, timers, stands).
Sustainable and wooden non-toxic toys are moving from niche to mainstream on parental preference — helpfully, they are also the format that survives a damp hill climate.

Screen-free family board and party games (UNO, sling-puck, pick-and-drop, Indian-theme titles from Kaadoo) are being marketed as a deliberate counter to screen time, and cheap tabletop games are the top q-commerce toy movers.
adjacentServices: Bicycle, tricycle and ride-on assembly at delivery, plus a basic repair bench (puncture, brake, chain) — mandatory to make big-ticket wheeled goods sellable 30-50 km from any market.
Ball inflation, badminton restringing and grip replacement — a two-minute service that pulls the whole sports-consumable basket in.
Birthday service bundle: pre-made return-gift packs + balloons + banner + gift wrapping, ordered a day ahead and picked up — a captive campus need with no alternative supplier.
Toy library / rental for expensive bulky items (ride-ons, large construction sets, big board games) — turns items with terrible hill freight economics into recurring revenue instead of dead stock.
Board-game and jigsaw exchange/swap shelf, and a blind-box trading noticeboard — costs nothing, drives repeat footfall on a closed campus.
Common-room game issue against a refundable deposit for hostels and departments (carrom, chess, TT sets) — institutional revenue rather than retail.
School-project counter: science-exhibition kit advice, craft raw materials by the piece, and a same-week indent for anything not in stock, timed to project-submission weeks.
Monsoon and winter craft/hobby workshops run in-store or with the school — sells kits and consumables in exactly the months when outdoor play stops.

Institutional price list and indent window for the Academy, University, hostels and sports department (sports day, annual function, primary-section learning toys) — bulk orders that consolidate hill freight.
Layaway / pocket-money ledger for boarders saving toward a ₹1,000+ item, and battery take-back and disposal so used cells do not end up on campus.
